verdict.line: You lose if you eat his Q-E all-in point-blank before level 6; you win if you survive to Trinity Force and stretch fights past his cooldowns.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's Deathbringer Stance sustain and Q-E combo let him win short trades and outheal poke through level 5-6, and World Ender at 6 turns any close skirmish into a loss for you. The 50.4% win rate over 524 games says Camille only closes that gap once Tactical Sweep-Hookshot lands cleanly and Trinity Force components come online, so this is a lane you play for scaling, not early dominance.

theirWindow.when: Aatrox lands W (Infernal Chains) on you
theirWindow.what: He drags you in, procs Deathbringer Stance, and chains into Q for a full combo that heals him back. Per OP.GG, use Hookshot [E] to break line of sight or reset distance immediately rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.when: His E is down after an aggressive dash-in
yourWindow.what: He has no clean disengage or re-engage tool for several seconds. Walk him down and land empowered W (Tactical Sweep) or commit E-Q-W for the all-in.

powerCurve.note: Q-E all-in threatens, your E isn't a combo tool yet
Sweep-Hookshot trades start matching his combo
World Ender heals him through skirmishes
Trinity Force components close the damage gap

start.why: 51% win rate over 447 games at 73.4% pick — the sustained AD and on-hit healing keep your short trades even with his Deathbringer Stance sustain during levels 1-5.

boots.why: 54.4% win rate over 397 games at 77.1% pick — his damage is almost entirely physical through auto-attacks and Q slashes, so flat reduction outvalues tenacity here.

core.why: Spellblade proc off your empowered auto turns short trade windows into real burst, which is how you close his early damage lead.
Lifesteal and cleave let you win a healing race against his passive instead of losing sustained trades outright.
Damage-over-time conversion plus healing reduction blunts the return damage from his Q-E combo when you commit to an all-in.

situational.when: he's stacking lifesteal/omnivamp and out-healing your trades through his passive and R
he's ahead in gold and threatens to burst you down before you can land your combo
you're already ahead and want to stack ability haste to reset E-W-Q faster in skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Extra sustain and max-health scaling matter directly against a lane defined by poke and a level 6-7 all-in window you have to survive; Bone Plating soaks the Q edge and W impact damage that opens his combo.

summoners.why: 51.2% win rate at 75.4% pick — Ignite's healing reduction directly counters the Deathbringer Stance and World Ender sustain loop that wins him extended fights, and Flash covers your lack of a hard engage before E is up.

playing.title: Count his Q slashes
playing.detail: The Darkin Blade is three sequential casts; back off after the first slash instead of standing through the full combo, since each extension hits harder.

playing.title: Respect chain range before 6
playing.detail: Don't stand in Infernal Chains range when his W is up — getting dragged into a wall is what starts his full combo and passive proc.

playing.title: Trade with Sweep's far edge
playing.detail: Land the true damage/heal edge of Tactical Sweep, not the near hit, to actually offset his passive sustain in short trades.

playing.title: Save Hookshot as an escape
playing.detail: If you get hit by W, use E on a wall or him immediately to break the follow-up before Q lands, per the matchup's own escape pattern.

playing.title: Play around his level 6-7 spike
playing.detail: World Ender heals him through skirmishes — disengage rather than extend a fight into his ultimate window.

playing.title: Buy anti-heal on sight of lifesteal
playing.detail: Executioner's Calling shuts down both his passive heal and his R sustain loop when he starts itemizing for it.

playing.title: All-in when his E is down
playing.detail: After he dashes in aggressively, Umbral Dash is on cooldown and he has no reset — commit your full combo in that window.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (524 games for this matchup); the timing, combo, and trade-pattern breakdown is my own tactical read, not part of the dataset.

stats.opponentTip: Keep some distance to avoid Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo! If Camille is hit with (W), use Hookshot [E] to escape quickly. Purchase items that reduce healing to fight Aatrox!
